title: Italian restaurant
content: Is anyone else every in a dim lit Italian restaurant or maybe even a pizza place? I used to work at a pizza place back in 2014 but I am now a server at a dimly lit restaurant. I wonder if that is why my subconscious brings this place up or if others have kind of seen it too? There are a few different restaurants I have visited.. sometimes I work at them or can see the floor plan from a Birds Eye view.
